lines.en: - Aw, who needs a hug? - Me.
I haven't had an asthma attack since I was seven.
- Well, yeah, but you know, you never know.
- Aw, and you're a smart little Carly.
- See, you should know, sometimes doing what's right
is more important than keeping a promise.
- Showing me that being a grown-up
doesn't mean you have to stop being silly.
But it shows that you have artistic potential.
You know, I don't have anything going on Saturday night.
I know I'm not dad, but can I take you to the dance?
